subjects.label: Kāvya / Literature
subjects.description: Literary poetry, prose, stories and anthologies; verse form alone is not sufficient.

subjects.label: Nāṭaka / Drama
subjects.description: Plays and dramatic literature.

subjects.label: Alaṅkāra / Poetics
subjects.description: Poetics, rhetoric, literary criticism and aesthetics.

subjects.label: Chandas / Prosody
subjects.description: Metre and prosody.

subjects.label: Vyākaraṇa / Grammar
subjects.description: Grammar, linguistic analysis, verbal roots and grammatical word lists.

subjects.label: Kośa / Lexicography
subjects.description: Dictionaries, vocabularies and lexicons, including specialist medical lexicons.

subjects.label: Veda
subjects.description: Vedic texts, Upaniṣads, Vedic recitation, phonetics and exegesis.

subjects.label: Itihāsa & Purāṇa
subjects.description: Epics, Purāṇas and identifiable extracts or commentaries.

subjects.label: Dharmaśāstra / Law & Duties
subjects.description: Religious law, customary duties, inheritance, purity and expiation.

subjects.label: Nīti / Ethics & Statecraft
subjects.description: Ethical instruction, didactic works, political conduct and statecraft.

subjects.label: Ritual & Pūjā
subjects.description: Sacrifice, worship, saṃskāras, śrāddha, vrata and practical ritual manuals.

subjects.label: Stotra & Devotion
subjects.description: Hymns, prayers, devotional songs, bhakti and hagiography across traditions.

subjects.label: Tantra & Āgama
subjects.description: Tantric scriptures, initiation, mantra, yantra and associated esoteric practices.

subjects.label: Vedānta
subjects.description: Vedānta across its schools and associated commentarial works.

subjects.label: Nyāya & Vaiśeṣika
subjects.description: Logic, epistemology, categories and the associated philosophical systems.

subjects.label: Mīmāṃsā
subjects.description: Pūrvamīmāṃsā, Vedic interpretation and ritual hermeneutics.

subjects.label: Sāṃkhya
subjects.description: Sāṃkhya philosophy and its commentarial literature.

subjects.label: Yoga
subjects.description: Pātañjala Yoga, haṭhayoga and related contemplative practice; medical uses of yoga do not qualify by themselves.

subjects.label: Astronomy
subjects.description: Astronomical calculations, planetary motion, eclipses and calendrics.

subjects.label: Astrology
subjects.description: Horoscopes, muhūrta, annual predictions and astrological interpretation.

subjects.label: Gaṇita / Mathematics
subjects.description: Arithmetic, algebra, geometry and mathematical methods.

subjects.label: Divination & Omens
subjects.description: Ramala, dreams, bird omens and other prognostic practices.

subjects.label: Āyurveda / Medicine
subjects.description: Medicine, pharmacology, therapeutic preparations and veterinary medicine.

subjects.label: Rasaśāstra / Alchemy
subjects.description: Alchemy, pharmaceutical processing and metallurgical preparations.

subjects.label: Arts & Practical Knowledge
subjects.description: Practical disciplines not covered elsewhere, such as architecture, letter-writing, geography and cookery; not a fallback for unidentified works.

subjects.label: Saṅgīta / Music
subjects.description: Musical theory and practice.

subjects.label: Kāmaśāstra / Erotics
subjects.description: Erotology and works on sexual conduct; romantic poetry alone does not qualify.

subjects.label: Tīrtha / Pilgrimage
subjects.description: Pilgrimage, sacred geography, descriptions of sacred places and their observances.

traditions.label: Buddhist
traditions.description: Explicitly Buddhist or securely identifiable Buddhist textual associations.

traditions.label: Jaina
traditions.description: Explicitly Jaina or securely identifiable Jaina textual associations.

traditions.label: Sikh
traditions.description: Sikh textual, liturgical or biographical associations.

traditions.label: Śaiva
traditions.description: Textual affiliation or sustained devotion to Śiva; not a claim about the manuscript owner's religion.

traditions.label: Vaiṣṇava
traditions.description: Textual affiliation or sustained devotion to Viṣṇu and his avatāras; not a claim about the manuscript owner's religion.

traditions.label: Śākta
traditions.description: Textual affiliation or sustained devotion to Devī; not a claim about the manuscript owner's religion.

confidence_labels.supported: Supported by the available catalogue evidence; not independently human-verified.
confidence_labels.uncertain: An inferred or ambiguous classification. See its evidence before relying on it.

unclassified_policy: An entry without sufficient subject evidence remains visibly unclassified. Absence of a tradition tag means unspecified, not absence of a religious affiliation.
